photos.c: Below: Chris Gearing has had a phenomenal year. We haven't yet caught up with how many times he improved our Under 17 Shot and Discus records but he's ended up with marks of 18.70 (5kg) and 51.41 (1.5kg) to top the UK Under 17 list with shot and place 3rd with discus, the former being a UK age-best and 15th best in the world this year. If that's not enough, he also tops the list in the Under 20 Men's shot with 17.49 (6kg) and is 4th in the discus with 49.06 (1.75kg). Chris still has two full years ahead of him before he becomes a senior but has already launched the heaviest men's implement a prodigious 15.43 metres.
